purpose: Machine-readable ledger of strategic claims, their current status, and the evidence that can demote them.

status_definitions.quarantined: Historically observed but invalid as a current baseline claim because a later control exposed a confound or exploit.
status_definitions.supported_local: Repeated within the stated policy/deck/seed scope; not a general game-theoretic statement.
status_definitions.provisional: Live hypothesis with suggestive evidence, broad uncertainty, or known response-policy sensitivity.
status_definitions.open: Question framed but not yet supported strongly enough to claim.

claims.title: Historical cf34 counter-wall edge over legacy public threat Overlord
claims.scope: cf34_counter_wall versus pub_threat_overlord/threat_rush at life 20 and 40
claims.current_read: The replicated scoreboard edge was real under the old opponent, but it does not survive the threat_closure control and must not be used as a general counter-wall claim.
claims.falsifier_or_rehabilitation_test: Re-establish an edge against a preregistered mixture of independently generated guarded threat policies on frozen holdout seeds.

claims.title: Library management and closure dominate the old matchup narrative
claims.scope: tested 40/60-card counter, inert-buffer, and Overlord shells under legacy and guarded public pilots
claims.current_read: Deck-size endurance, opponent overdraw, and failure to close explain much of the historical signal; active control components matter in selected life-20 cells but not enough to rescue the old broad story.
claims.boundary: This is a local mechanism claim about named shells and pilots, not a theorem about control decks or Magic generally.

claims.title: counter_guard is a live response candidate against guarded threat policies
claims.scope: counter_guard against threat_closure, threat_pressure, and threat_surge across three deck-size axes and two life totals
claims.current_read: The response survives in several cells but is policy-ladder-sensitive and underpowered. It is not a promoted robust strategy.
claims.next_test: Evaluate a policy population and meta-strategy on frozen holdout seeds; report approximate exploitability or worst-case regret rather than a single opponent score.

claims.title: 60-vs-60 life-40 is the strongest current threat-side pressure point
claims.current_read: counter_guard scores 0.8333 against threat_pressure but 0.4167 against threat_surge in this cell; the effect is notable but confidence intervals remain broad and the surge result was seed-sensitive elsewhere.
claims.next_test: Paired common-random-number replication with preregistered stopping and a held-out response set.

claims.title: MUC-5 can invalidate its own attractive strategic stories
claims.current_read: The project replicated, decomposed, demoted, and quarantined a flattering claim after stronger controls exposed library-buffer and opponent-closure confounds.
claims.mission_implication: The highest-value capability is adversarial claim correction, not raw win-rate production.
